name: agent-vault-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-vault and assert its standalone local KeePassXC-backed secret-store contract on a fresh machine. The scenario proves the plugin payload installs, the session hook plus first-use binstub provision the runtime, the agent-vault binstub exposes a real non-empty --version, the POSIX vault-askpass SUDO_ASKPASS helper is deployed, and read/idempotent verbs (vault list, which, cache-status, ping, list) either exit 0 or report a clean no-vault-configured/locked condition without tracebacks. It records keepassxc-cli presence as information only and never requires a real unlocked .kdbx. Name-free / public.

stages.title: runtime self-provisions through session hook + first-use binstub
